parsed.observations: Detached wheat leaves show white to grey, raised cottony colonies, extensive ageing grey-brown surface growth with dark specks, and scattered small orange-brown pustules. Several leaves are yellowing with brown necrotic areas; pustules do not form stripes.
parsed.summary: Powdery mildew predominates, evidenced by extensive white-grey cottony colonies with dark specks, alongside leaf rust indicated by scattered orange-brown pustules.
